Application Data.NAME: Quality Carpentry Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Quality Carpentry Solutions specializes in custom woodworking and carpentry services, including the design and construction of residential and commercial furniture, cabinetry, and millwork. Our operations involve both in-house production and installation, with a commitment to quality craftsmanship and client satisfaction. We also offer repair and refinishing services for existing wood structures, ensuring that we adhere to industry best practices and environmental standards. We work closely with subcontractors for delivery and installation tasks, ensuring they are properly insured to minimize risk. Our facility is located in Springfield, IL, where we also undertake small-scale retail operations for local customers.

Underwriting Guidelines:
Industry-Specific Restrictions
• Subcontractor claims exclusion: Claims arising from subcontracted delivery or instal-
lation work are excluded unless the subcontractor maintains separate, verifiable insurance
coverage with limits at least equal to the insured’s policy limits. This restriction protects the
insurer from vicarious liability for uninsured subcontractor actions.
• Online-only operations: Businesses with primarily online sales (over 75%) must be rated
separately and are required to carry cyber liability insurance to address data breach and
e-commerce risks.
• Repair and refinishing operations: If the insured performs repair, refinishing, or restora-
tion services, these activities require an appropriate liability endorsement to cover potential
damages from chemical use, surface damage, or improper restoration.
• Restriction on imported exotic woods: Furniture stores sourcing or installing furniture
